literal_meaning: ঘন কালোর অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (reduplicative form indicating intense blackness)
example_sentences_in_english: The darkness of the night has become pitch black.
The room was enveloped in inky black darkness.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to vividly describe profound darkness, rooted in everyday linguistic traditions.
